ELECTRICITY — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.

2. When learning Electrical Diagrams, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Diagrams.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Diagrams.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Diagrams.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Diagrams.

3. When learning Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

4. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

5. When learning Power Supplies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Supplies.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Power Supplies.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Power Supplies.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Supplies.

6. When learning Earthing and Excess Current Protection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.

   D. Skip safety briefings for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.

7. When learning Measuring Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring Instruments.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Measuring Instruments.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring Instruments.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring Instruments.

8. When learning Electronics 4.4 Project Identification, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.

9. When learning DC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for DC Generators.
   B. Skip safety briefings for DC Generators.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after DC Generators.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for DC Generators.

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

11. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

12. When learning Inspection and Testing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inspection and Testing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Inspection and Testing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Inspection and Testing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Inspection and Testing.

13. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

14. When learning Single Phase AC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Generators.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Generators.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Generators.

15. When learning Single Phase AC Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Circuits.

16. When learning Wiring Systems and Regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wiring Systems and Regulations.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Single Phase AC Generators and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Wiring Systems and Regulations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
